data.bottom_line: The avalanche danger will worsen throughout the day on Saturday with new snow and strong westerly winds. The most dangerous slopes, where you can trigger an avalanche large enough to bury you, are northeast- and east-facing slopes where the wind-drifted snow is rapidly accumulating on buried weak layers. For safer travel options, seek out wind-sheltered terrain where your feet, skis, or machine easily sink deep into the snow, and you don't see any cracking in the snow as you travel across it.
